domains.name: Laboratory Instrument Records
domains.scope: Reconcile laboratory instrument identity, status chronology and affected-record evidence from supplied records without technical fitness determinations.

skills.name: calibration-certificate-asset-correspondence
skills.description: Match calibration documents to instrument identity and requested record scope when certificates may refer to similar or replacement assets.

skills.name: instrument-use-calibration-timeline
skills.description: Reconstruct instrument-use and calibration-status chronology from supplied records when a later status change may affect review of earlier runs.

skills.name: out-of-tolerance-affected-record-inventory
skills.description: Build a traceable candidate inventory after an instrument status notice identifies an out-of-tolerance condition, when run records may need owner review.
